title: Research: Turkish TTS and voice cloning options
objective: Survey open-source TTS and voice cloning options for Turkish language support as they apply to the AI Media Factory dubbing pipeline. Cover: Coqui XTTS-v2 (explicit Turkish support, MPL-2.0), CosyVoice 2.0 (Apache 2.0, zero-shot, multilingual), F5-TTS (CC-BY-NC-4.0 – flag licensing risk), Kokoro-82M (Apache 2.0, lightweight ONNX). For each: zero-shot voice cloning quality, reference audio length needed, supported languages including Turkish, inference latency on CPU/GPU, license. Recommend a primary and a fallback adapter. Write results to docs/research/RESEARCH-TTS-001.md only.
